schedule.message: 本次排程執行的工具清單中依然沒有 Notion 連接器（已連續第四天），所以無法自動撈今天的事件，進度條顯示 0%、清單是空的——這不代表今天真的沒事。今天是 8/12（週三），距離 9 月開學剩不到三週，行政死線開始密集。建議自己開 Notion「事件／我的任務」補三件從信箱長出來、有明確日期的事：① 8/14（五）國際學者跨域講座「A Few Lessons from the Dragonfly」，後天就要辦、現在開放報名，是這批信裡最急的；② NCKU SPARK 徵案 8/17（一）截止，只剩 5 天；③ 8/20（四）10:00–12:00「人工智慧在能資源管理之應用」講座，這場跟化工最對口，講地熱鑽井效率預測、電網電源管理最佳化，是可以直接寫進履歷與專題的內容。另外化工系直接寄來的「第 5 屆大專校院綠色化學創意競賽」雖然 10/30 才截止，但要組隊＋做作品，今天就該把「找隊友」放進行事曆。以上都在下面信件區有「加入行事曆」按鈕，可以直接推進 Notion。

items.tag: 成大 · 國際學者跨域講座 · 8/11 01:07
items.title: 🦟 8/14 國際學者跨域講座：A Few Lessons from the Dragonfly — From Biological Sensing to Autonomous Systems
items.deadline: 講座 2026/8/14（五）· 即日起開放報名
items.kind: 需報名（後天就要辦，名額有限，今天不報就沒了）
items.detail: 這批信裡時間最急的一封。主講人是英國倫敦帝國學院（Imperial College London）生物工程系林懷玓博士（Dr. Huai-Ti Lin），他主持的 NBits 實驗室跨神經科學與生物力學，研究蜻蜓的視覺追蹤與飛行敏捷度如何轉化成人工智慧與自主系統技術，並開發出 DART 追蹤平台。對你的價值不在「化工本科」，而在跨域方法論——生物感測 → 控制系統 → 自主決策這條線，跟你做專題時要處理的感測、建模、最佳化是同一套思路，而且是能寫進 SOP 的國際學者接觸機會。要做的事：今天就上報名系統卡位，順便看看講座是否提供英文投影片（若要練英文技術聽力，這是免費的高品質素材）。

calendar.title: 國際學者跨域講座（蜻蜓／自主系統）
calendar.label: ➕ 加入行事曆（8/14 講座）

items.tag: 成大 · 化學工程學系 · 8/11 02:06
items.title: 🧪 第 5 屆大專校院綠色化學創意競賽 — 報名至 115/10/30（五）18:00
items.kind: 需決策＋要組隊（截止日遠，但作品要做，今天該找隊友）
items.detail: 由【化學工程學系】直接發出，是這七封裡唯一「你的系親自點名」的信。綠色化學創意競賽走的是製程減量、替代溶劑、能源效率、循環再利用這類題目，跟化工系的單元操作、反應工程、程序設計課程高度重疊——換句話說，你的專題題目很可能稍微轉個角度就能同時投這個競賽，一份工作拿兩份產出。截止日 10/30 看起來還很遠，但競賽真正的瓶頸不是報名，是「找到隊友＋把想法做成可展示的成果」，這兩件通常吃掉 2–3 個月。今天要做的事只有一件：把「找 2–3 個化工同學組隊」丟進行事曆，開學第一週就開口問。取消訂閱系上信件請登入 https://cncmail.ncku.edu.tw/loginuser/ （需校內 IP）。

items.title: ⚡ 8/20 講座【人工智慧在「能資源」管理之應用】
items.kind: 需報名（化工最對口的一場，值得排時間）
items.detail: 三大實務案例：① 地熱鑽井效率預測與異常偵測 ② 電動車能源效率因子評估 ③ 電網電源管理最佳化。這場是七封信裡跟化工工程實務距離最近的——「異常偵測」對應到程序控制的 fault detection，「電網電源管理最佳化」本質上就是有約束條件的最佳化問題（constrained optimization），跟你在程序設計課會碰到的東西是同一類數學。如果你之後想往「化工 + AI／製程數據分析」這個組合走，這種產業實務分享比課本更能告訴你業界現在真的在做什麼。時間是週四上午 10–12 點，開學前還排得進去。

calendar.title: 講座：AI 在能資源管理之應用

items.kind: 待確認（生醫團隊導向，先確認在學大學生能不能投）
items.detail: 成大 SPARK 接軌史丹佛 SPARK Program 培訓模式，今年是第十三年，由成大醫院許耿福醫師主持，做的是生醫創新轉譯——透過法規、智財、市場與商業規劃培訓，把實驗室成果推向產品化。徵件對象寫的是「生醫創新團隊」，通常以有明確技術標的的研究團隊（教授＋研究生）為主，大學部單獨投的機率不高。要做的事只有一通信／一通電話：確認在學大學生能否以團隊成員身分參與。若不能，就當作資訊收著——化工在生醫材料、藥物載體、生物製程這幾塊其實有位置，明後年若跟到相關實驗室，這個計畫會重新變得相關。5 天內要有答案。

items.kind: 選擇性參加（通識／興趣導向，含宋江陣展演）
items.detail: 成大人社中心主辦，以臺灣傳統「做 16 歲」文化為起點，延伸到不同地區與文化的生命禮俗，內容包含宋江陣展演、成年禮經驗分享、主題論壇與東南亞禮俗文化特展。這封信對你的工程主線沒有直接幫助，但兩個實際用途：① 如果你這學期還缺通識或人文類的參與紀錄，兩天的論壇是低成本的補法；② 宋江陣展演與特展屬於「去看就有收穫」的類型，暑假最後一週當作換腦袋的活動很合適。優先度放中偏低，行程有衝突就直接跳過。

items.en: Magnitude 7.4 Earthquake Kills More Than 160 in Colombia; State of Emergency Declared
items.zh: 哥倫比亞規模 7.4 強震逾 160 死，總統宣布進入緊急狀態
items.summary: A magnitude 7.4 earthquake struck Colombia's northwestern Chocó department and neighbouring regions, killing more than 160 people, with officials warning the death toll will climb as search and rescue teams reach isolated communities. President Abelardo de la Espriella declared a state of emergency and deployed military units to the worst-hit areas. Chocó is one of Colombia's poorest and least accessible departments, with limited road links and hospitals, which is slowing the delivery of aid. Aftershocks continued through the night, forcing residents to sleep outdoors and complicating structural assessments of damaged buildings.

items.en: US-Iran Standoff Hardens as Tehran Rules Out Talks Without Compensation; Hormuz Stays Shut
items.zh: 美伊僵局升溫，伊朗要求賠償才願重啟談判，荷姆茲海峽持續封閉
items.summary: Iranian foreign minister Abbas Araghchi said there is no possibility of restarting negotiations until Washington compensates Iran for violations of the June memorandum of understanding. President Trump rebuked Iran's demand for reparations, telling Axios the United States is only semi-negotiating and will wait for economic pressure to build. Oil prices climbed for a second session on the impasse, since the Strait of Hormuz carries roughly a fifth of the world's seaborne crude. Asian importers including Taiwan, Japan and South Korea face the sharpest exposure to sustained freight and insurance cost increases.

items.en: US Appeals Court Lets Thousands of Addiction Lawsuits Proceed Against Meta, Google, TikTok and Snap
items.zh: 美國上訴法院裁定：控告 Meta、Google、TikTok、Snapchat 產品成癮設計的數千件訴訟可繼續進行
items.summary: A federal appeals court in San Francisco allowed thousands of lawsuits to proceed against Meta, Google, TikTok and Snapchat over claims their products were deliberately designed to be addictive to young users. The ruling rejects the platforms' attempt to have the cases dismissed wholesale under Section 230 immunity, holding that design choices such as infinite scroll and engagement-optimised recommendation can be treated as product defects rather than protected publishing decisions. The decision opens the door to discovery into internal engagement research and is the most significant legal setback for the platforms on youth safety to date.

items.en: Haitian Immigrants in Ohio Ordered to Wear Ankle Monitors After TPS Termination
items.zh: 美方終止海地 TPS 身分，俄亥俄州海地移民被要求配戴電子腳環並定期向 ICE 報到
items.summary: Haitian immigrants in Ohio are being required to report to ICE appointments and wear ankle monitors after the Trump administration formally ended temporary protected status for Haiti, stripping deportation relief from hundreds of thousands of people. Community organisers in Springfield say families who have lived and worked legally in the state for years are now facing removal proceedings, and that employers are beginning to terminate workers whose work authorisation lapsed with the TPS designation. Legal aid groups have filed emergency challenges arguing the termination did not follow required country-conditions review.

items.en: Fed Rate-Hike Bets Build for September as Cleveland Fed's Hammack Warns One Move May Not Be Enough
items.zh: 聯準會 9 月「升息」押注升溫，克里夫蘭聯準銀行總裁 Hammack 警告一次可能不夠
items.summary: Traders shifted toward pricing a Federal Reserve rate hike in September after Cleveland Fed president Beth Hammack said it may take more than one interest rate increase to bring inflation back down. The repricing follows a softer-than-expected jobs report and a renewed climb in oil prices tied to the Hormuz closure, an unusual combination that pushes growth and inflation in opposite directions. Wednesday's Consumer Price Index report is now the single largest near-term catalyst for both equities and the dollar, with consensus looking for headline inflation around 3.4 percent.

items.en: Nvidia Teams With Six Large Asset Managers to Mobilise More Than $500 Billion for AI Infrastructure
items.zh: 輝達聯手六大資產管理公司，動員逾 5,000 億美元投入 AI 基礎建設
items.summary: Nvidia said it is partnering with six large asset managers to mobilise more than $500 billion for artificial intelligence infrastructure, a vehicle designed to finance data centres, power and networking rather than chips alone. The scale of the commitment underlines how AI build-out has moved from corporate capital expenditure into structured project finance. Investors reacted cautiously: Nvidia gave up an early gain to close just below the flatline on Tuesday, as analysts questioned whether vendor-adjacent financing structures amount to circular funding that flatters demand without adding genuinely new end customers.

items.en: CoreWeave and Super Micro Beat Estimates, Easing Fears Over AI Hardware Demand
items.zh: CoreWeave、美超微財報雙雙優於預期，暫時安撫 AI 硬體需求疑慮
items.summary: CoreWeave reported second-quarter revenue of $2.58 billion, more than double a year earlier, with a narrower than expected loss of $1.14 a share against a projected $1.41. The company disclosed a $104 billion sales backlog plus a further $25 billion of commitments earmarked for the third quarter, and guided 2026 revenue to $12.4 to $13.2 billion. Super Micro also beat and issued a robust first-quarter outlook. Both stocks jumped after hours, CoreWeave more than eight percent and Super Micro more than nine, providing a counterweight to the day's circular-financing anxiety.

items.en: Alphabet Slides Again as 2026 Capex Guidance Rises to $195-205 Billion and Free Cash Flow Turns Negative
items.zh: Alphabet 再跌 3.8%：2026 資本支出上調至 1,950–2,050 億美元，自由現金流首度轉負
items.summary: Alphabet shares fell about 3.8 percent, a fourth losing session in five, after the company raised its 2026 capital expenditure forecast to between $195 billion and $205 billion. Quarterly capex doubled year on year to $44.9 billion, pushing free cash flow negative for the first time. The slide compounds pressure from last week's reshuffle of Google's artificial intelligence divisions and lands days before the Pixel 11 launch. The move captures a broader rotation: investors are no longer rewarding hyperscalers simply for spending more on AI, and now want visible returns.

items.en: Twins Beat Orioles 9-5 Behind Kremer's Seven Strong Innings and Six Combined RBIs
items.zh: 雙城 9:5 擊敗金鶯，Kremer 主投七局好投、Jeffers 與 Bell 各進帳三分打點
items.summary: The Minnesota Twins defeated the Baltimore Orioles 9-5, with Dean Kremer delivering seven strong innings on the mound. Ryan Jeffers and Josh Bell each contributed three runs batted in, accounting for six of the nine Minnesota runs between them. The win continues a stretch of productive offence for a Twins lineup that had struggled for extra-base hits earlier in the month, and comes at a point in the calendar when both clubs are still calculating their positions ahead of the postseason race.

items.en: Angels Fire Pitching Coach Mike Maddux and Bullpen Coach Dom Chiti
items.zh: 洛杉磯天使解雇投手教練 Mike Maddux 與牛棚教練 Dom Chiti
items.summary: The Los Angeles Angels dismissed pitching coach Mike Maddux and bullpen coach Dom Chiti, a mid-season staff shake-up that signals the organisation's frustration with a pitching group that has underperformed relative to preseason expectations. Maddux is one of the more experienced pitching coaches in the sport, and his removal in August rather than at season's end suggests the club wants a different voice working with its young arms through the remainder of the schedule rather than waiting for the offseason.

items.en: NBA Christmas Day Slate Announced: Timberwolves to Host Thunder
items.zh: NBA 耶誕大戰對戰表出爐，灰狼主場迎戰雷霆
items.summary: The National Basketball Association announced part of its Christmas Day schedule, with the Minnesota Timberwolves confirmed to host the Oklahoma City Thunder. The Christmas slate is the league's marquee regular-season showcase and placement on it is treated as a signal of which teams the league expects to contend. For Minnesota, a home Christmas game marks continued national-television recognition after several strong seasons, while the Thunder matchup pairs two of the Western Conference's most-watched young cores.

items.en: New Editorial Finds Pandemic's Effects on Student Mental Health Did Not End When Campuses Reopened
items.zh: 最新社論指出：疫情對學生心理健康的衝擊並未隨校園重啟而結束
items.summary: An editorial published on 10 August 2026 in Frontiers in Education argues that the long-term consequences of the COVID-19 pandemic remain a pressing issue for educational research, because the crisis did not end when schools and universities reopened. Instead it reconfigured the emotional, social and institutional conditions under which education takes place. The authors call for intervention strategies that target underlying mechanisms, such as disrupted peer networks and weakened routines, rather than treating elevated anxiety and disengagement as a temporary backlog that will clear on its own.

items.en: 2026 Data: 83% of Teens Name Academic Pressure as a Major Source of Stress
items.zh: 2026 年統計：83% 青少年將學業壓力列為主要壓力來源
items.summary: Recent 2026 figures show that 83 percent of teenagers cite academic pressure as a major source of stress, underlining how school-related demands weigh on young people's mental health. The same body of research reports that about 25 percent of male student-athletes and 30 percent of female student-athletes said they felt overwhelmed by their responsibilities. Researchers note the gap between male and female athletes has persisted across survey years, suggesting the driver is workload distribution and expectation rather than a difference in reporting willingness.

items.en: Student and Educator Mental Health Moves From the Margins to the Centre of Public Health Policy
items.zh: 學生與教師的心理健康，從教育政策邊緣移到公共衛生議程中心
items.summary: A Frontiers in Public Health editorial reports that the mental health of students and educators has moved from the margins of educational policy to the centre of public health debate. The authors argue for treating schools and universities as public health settings in their own right, with population-level strategies rather than referral-only counselling models. Practical implications include embedding screening in routine academic administration, training faculty to recognise early warning signs, and measuring institutional workload as a modifiable risk factor rather than an unavoidable feature of study.

items.en: TSMC July Revenue Hits NT$467.58 Billion, Up About 45% Year on Year
items.zh: 台積電 7 月營收 4,675.8 億元、年增約 45%，全年美元營收成長目標上調至逾 40%
items.summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company reported July revenue of NT$467.58 billion, roughly $14.5 billion, up about 45 percent from a year earlier. The company recently raised its 2026 dollar-denominated revenue growth outlook to more than 40 percent while continuing to expand advanced packaging capacity such as CoWoS, which has become the binding constraint on high-performance AI accelerator supply. Separately TSMC is increasing US investment by $100 billion, taking the total commitment to $265 billion following agreements with the Trump administration.

items.en: Intel Raises $15 Billion to Fund Its Own AI Infrastructure Push
items.zh: 英特爾募資 150 億美元，投入 AI 基礎建設競賽
items.summary: Intel raised $15 billion to chase the same artificial intelligence infrastructure boom that is driving record capital expenditure across the sector. The fundraising sits alongside Nvidia's much larger asset-manager vehicle and is part of what analysts are now describing as an industry-wide shift toward external financing of AI capacity. The scale of simultaneous raising has revived concerns about circular financing, where chip vendors help fund the customers who buy their chips, a structure that can flatter reported demand without adding genuinely independent buyers.

items.en: Quantum Computing Inc. Posts Q2 Results, Closes NHanced Semiconductors Deal and Opens Fab 2
items.zh: Quantum Computing Inc. 公布 Q2 財報，完成併購 NHanced Semiconductors 並啟用 Fab 2
items.summary: Quantum Computing Inc. released results for the three months ended 30 June 2026, reporting that it completed the strategic acquisition of NHanced Semiconductors and is launching Fab 2 to advance roadmap initiatives and expand US-based manufacturing capability. The company ended the quarter with $1.3 billion in cash, cash equivalents and investments. The move is notable because it converts a pure-play quantum research company into one with domestic packaging and fabrication assets, a pattern increasingly common as quantum firms seek revenue from conventional semiconductor services while their core technology matures.

items.en: Mrs. GREEN APPLE Confirms Sixth Album for 30 September After 390,000-Fan Stadium Tour
items.zh: Mrs. GREEN APPLE 第六張專輯確定 9/30 發行，體育場巡演累計 39 萬人次、台港曾設 Live Viewing
items.summary: Mrs. GREEN APPLE has confirmed that its sixth studio album arrives on 30 September, following the conclusion of the ZENJIN MITO TO IM/MUTABLE stadium tour at Japan National Stadium in July. The run, which also took in Yanmar Stadium Nagai in May, drew roughly 390,000 fans in total and was accompanied by live viewing screenings in Hong Kong and Taiwan. The band additionally announced its first arena tour in three years, which is the more realistic ticketing target for overseas fans than the stadium shows were.

items.en: YOASOBI's Largest North American Tour 'NEVER ENDING STORIES' Under Way, Finale at the Hollywood Bowl
items.zh: YOASOBI 生涯最大規模北美巡演「NEVER ENDING STORIES」開跑，壓軸為 2 萬人的好萊塢露天劇場
items.summary: YOASOBI's largest North American tour to date, NEVER ENDING STORIES, opened in Boston on 4 August and continues through Brooklyn, Hamilton, Seattle and Oakland before a finale at the roughly 20,000-capacity Hollywood Bowl in Los Angeles, with festival appearances at OSHEAGA in Montreal and Lollapalooza in Chicago. The tour is paired with the fourth English-language EP E-SIDE 4, a nine-track set including the recent songs ADRENA and BABY. No Taiwan, Hong Kong or Japan dates have been attached to this run.

items.en: tuki. Completes First Overseas Shows: Taipei Arena Sold Out, Hong Kong Leg Followed
items.zh: tuki. 首次海外公演落幕：台北小巨蛋兩場完售，香港站接續舉行
items.summary: tuki. completed the Taipei leg of the 1st ASIA TOUR 2026 at Taipei Arena on 4 and 5 April, doors at 15:30 and start at 17:00 on both days, with tickets ranging from NT$800 to NT$5,280 and both nights selling out. It was the singer-songwriter's first overseas performance, and the Hong Kong date followed on the same Asia run. For fans in Taiwan the practical takeaway is that tuki. now has a proven sell-out record locally, which makes a return date on any subsequent Asia tour considerably more likely.

items.en: Watchlist Check: No New Tour, Album or Merchandise Announcements From Ado, LiSA, Aimer or Yonezu Kenshi in the Past 48 Hours
items.zh: 清單巡檢：Ado、LiSA、Aimer、米津玄師 過去 48 小時無新巡演／專輯／周邊公告
items.summary: A sweep of the tracked artist list found no new tour, album or merchandise announcements in the past 48 hours from Ado, LiSA, Aimer, Yonezu Kenshi, King Gnu, Official HIGE DANdism, back number, Vaundy, RADWIMPS, Fujii Kaze, Aimyon, Yuuri or YUIKA. Coverage in this window was dominated by Mrs. GREEN APPLE's album date and YOASOBI's North American run. Note that Japanese acts typically announce autumn and winter Asia legs between late August and October, so the next meaningful window for Taiwan and Hong Kong dates is a few weeks away.

market.note: 昨天兩邊都是「小幅度、大換手」的一天。台股 8/11 開低震盪後翻紅，終場漲 191.96 點收 45,120.72（+0.43%），成功站回 45K，成交量約 8,690 億——注意量能比 8/10 的 9,020 億縮了一些，指數卻續攻，代表這是換股而不是加碼。族群輪動非常明確：資金從記憶體撤出、轉進被動元件。國巨 7 月合併營收 161.31 億元創單月歷史新高，股價噴逾 7%，帶著華新科、禾伸堂一起走強，MLCC 成了新的主攻方向；反過來，前一天雙雙漲停的南亞科跌逾 2.5%、華邦電與旺宏跌逾 0.7%，昨天那根漲停就是短線高點。權值股撐住盤面：台積電收 2,395 元（+15 元、+0.63%）、聯發科收 4,020 元（+60 元、+1.52%）重返 4 字頭。美股 8/11 則是三大指數同步小跌（S&P -0.32% 收 7,728.20、那斯達克 -0.6% 收 26,445.45、道瓊 -184.13 點收 53,791.85），空方來源有兩個：一是美伊談判談崩、油價續漲，二是「循環融資」疑慮重新發酵——輝達宣布聯手六大資產管理公司動員逾 5,000 億美元投入 AI 基建、英特爾同時募資 150 億美元，市場開始質疑晶片商幫客戶出錢買自己晶片這件事到底創造了多少真實需求。輝達早盤漲勢被吃掉、收盤幾乎平盤，Alphabet 因資本支出上調到 1,950–2,050 億美元、自由現金流首度轉負而跌約 3.8%，蘋果跌逾 1%。盤後 CoreWeave 財報營收翻倍至 25.8 億美元、backlog 1,040 億美元，股價漲逾 8%；美超微也優於預期漲逾 9%，這兩張成績單多少沖淡了白天的疑慮。
market.highlight: ⚠️ 今天開盤前三件事：① 台股記憶體的答案昨天已經揭曉——8/10 漲停、8/11 就回吐，前天晨報提的「時間差風險」實現了，資金轉去 MLCC／被動元件。今天要看的是國巨這根 7% 是「營收創高的一日行情」還是新主流的起點，觀察華新科、禾伸堂有沒有跟上量。② 今晚 20:30（台北時間）美國 7 月 CPI 公布，市場共識約 3.4%。特別注意風向已經翻了——克里夫蘭聯準銀行總裁 Hammack 說「一次升息可能不夠」，交易員現在押的是 9 月「升息」而非降息；如果 CPI 超預期，昨天撐盤的權值股會是第一批被砍的。③ 「循環融資」是這週美股最重要的敘事：輝達 5,000 億美元 AI 基建計畫＋英特爾 150 億美元募資，市場開始把 AI 資本支出當成風險而不是利多，Alphabet 已經連五盤跌了四盤。這條敘事若延燒，台股 AI 伺服器供應鏈（緯創、緯穎、廣達、台達電）會直接被掃到，但短線盤後 CRWV／SMCI 的好財報是反向支撐——兩股力量今天會正面對撞。
